prior_form_and_archive_acceptance.boundary: Prior adapter. Browser save/clone, local archive with native key, and synthetic restore were verified there. No fresh browser or restore execution in this standard-worker case.

actual_app.environment: Native Linux x86_64 Alpine with network-none, unprivileged, read-only container and owned writable tmpfs. Actual started App, installed Go process, SQLite and local filesystem. Loopback fixture supplies only the exact package index and ZIP.
observations: Installed the exact indexed Linux amd64 ZIP through the App repository install endpoint. Read its native local-only form with VCronField and the source immediate switch.

With enabled=false, initialization persisted onlyonce=false and the private +3-second callback produced a private timestamped ZIP. ctime rotation deleted the old bk file and retained an unrelated file. SQLite integrity_check passed, the committed marker and category were present, and the archived encryption key matched the owned store.
Enabled plus cron registered the public service. Manual invocation through the actual host scheduler published another archive, including same-second atomic replacement.

The framework rejected a bad key, and a valid header plus mismatched query reached the plugin-specific failure. A valid key could not create the ungranted destination. After a local root grant, the same saved config produced a private ZIP and the source success tuple. The default archive remained in place.
actual_app.cleanup: Remote owned container and staged input removed. Local App fixture executable removed after SHA-256 binding.
actual_app.build_note: A pre-execution compile overlapped final host edits and was discarded after hash mismatch. The final committed host was compiled and the real App case ran once.

adaptations_and_limits: Archive retains source filename, optional category and local retention ordering. Native SQLite snapshot and matching key replace MoviePilot user.db* and app.env/cookies storage. The SQLite and encryption key stay within the host, with archive mode 0600.

The implicit destination is each instance private data directory. Explicit paths require the existing local write grant and no-follow checks. Retention and same-second overwrite protect unrelated managed paths.
WebDAV/cloud storage excluded by user. PostgreSQL installer/dump is inapplicable to the native SQLite host. The installed plugin has no restore entry, data page or command. No new core backup API.

The current fixture reads the native form and runs the host lifecycle. Prior Chrome, clone and notification coverage is recorded separately. This case did not exercise a live notification provider or replay private source data.

review.scope: Fixed source behavior, reusable archive host code, authorization and local form/clone behavior. Coordinator ran one fresh targeted native App scenario.
